result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B covers more of the rubric. It has a working retry button, an accessible name on each Download link that says which month it belongs to, and a :focus-visible ring. A only tells users to refresh the page and leaves the identical 'Download' links unnamed and without a focus style, though it does a better job on money formatting by suggesting Intl.NumberFormat and a header row. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Answer A covers loading, empty, and error states, and its error state has a real retry button. Its Download control is a link with an aria-label that names the month and a visible :focus-visible ring. Answer B also handles loading, empty, and error states, and it adds useful notes on CSP and on download navigation, but its error message only says to refresh the page, its link has no name that identifies the statement, and it adds no focus style.
